messages.subject: How to cite stan? And other questions relevant to the publication process.
parts:
Dear Stan team,
I am a b-school academic, and apply bayesian methods to pricing, etc. I am writing a manuscript. How should I cite STAN and the technology behind stand HMC, NUTS. I am aware of the traditional articles, but if there is an accepted way to cite STAN, I would like to know.
